text: A failed response does not mean the operation failed.
The server stores the order, then our test closes the connection.
The client sees an error. The first order still exists.
Retry without a key: a second order is created.
Create one key per logical operation. Keep it for every retry.
The server matches the key and payload, then replays the stored result.
Retry with the same key: the original order returns. No duplicate.
Same key, different payload? Reject it instead of creating another order.
